narrative: Today's tech brief highlights the increasing integration of AI in software development, with Endava leveraging AI agents and Google introducing the laptop-friendly Gemma 4 model. Key advancements also include enhanced consumer technology, significant funding in the tech sector, and new regulations impacting device design. Space exploration continues with striking images from Artemis II, while critical infrastructure sees improvements in resilience through multi-region replication.
